title: feat(plugin-grid): selected rows get one bar floating at the bottom centre of the list
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu2Mjk8ZWmMZxpXyNE5d5QSn)_

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWRZyWba1HhfWN7hKy

Fixes #35678

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 勾选行后，列表区域底部居中浮起一条小栏：「已选 N 条」和 ×，最多 3 个带文字的操作，其余进「更多」；操作不超过 3 个时全部是按钮（只有删除时删除就是按钮）。
- 栏浮在合计行之上，列表末尾留出空间让最后一行完整露出；整页勾满且还有更多匹配时出「选择全部 N 条」；× 或 Esc 清空。页面顶部不再随勾选变化。
- 主列表、子表页签、侧边记录、嵌入表格共用这一条栏；旧的底部条和视图栏的「已选」face 都删了。列表页上只勾一条时显示这条记录自己的操作（行上没有操作列）；其他位置一律显示批量操作。
- 风险：动了 ObjectGrid、data-table、列表页头三个热文件；浏览器 spec 跑出两个真问题已修（详见 Verification）。三个 i18n 键因此不再被读，留作后续卡。

## What changes

**One floating selection bar** (`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/components/SelectionBar.tsx`, replacing `SelectionPageBar.tsx` and the old strip in `BulkActionBar.tsx`):

- Count chip 「已选 N 条」 and ×, then up to `SELECTION_EXPOSED_ACTIONS = 3` labelled actions, the rest behind 「更多」. When the selection offers no more than three actions, every one is a button, Delete included (`planExposedEntries`). Over three, the first three non-destructive actions are buttons and Delete goes behind 「更多」, last.
- A narrow host gives actions back to 「更多」 one at a time until the bar fits on one line (`useFittedCount`). It re-measures when the host's width changes and when the bar's own box changes (a font or stylesheet that arrives late).
- 「选择全部 N 条」 shows when every loaded row is selected and more match. Over the 5000 cap, the offer, the chip and the chip's title name the cap (#28552 strings, unchanged).
- × clears the selection. Esc clears it unless the key belongs to a field, or to another open dialog/menu/listbox/popper that does not hold the bar. A grid inside the record drawer still clears on Esc.
- Look: `bg-popover`, rounded, shadow. In dark mode the border is `dark:border-foreground/20`, so the edge stays visible.

**Where it floats** (no inline styles; utility classes only):

- Flat table: a new runtime slot `DataTableSchema.floatingBar` (`ui/packages/types/src/data-display.ts`, refused by the zod twin with `handlerKeyRefusal` like the other runtime slots, KnownDrift ledger updated). `data-table.tsx` draws it in a zero-height sticky anchor after its scroll box, 12px above the bottom, or above the summary row when one is drawn. It also adds a spacer row (`data-table-floating-bar-room`) after the last row, so that row scrolls clear of the bar.
- Card face, grouped cards, grouped table: `FloatingSelectionBarAnchor`, drawn right after the face's scroller, with `pb-16` room inside the scroller.
- Because the anchor sits outside the scroller, the bar holds at the bottom of the page's own scroller when the face grows with its rows (a child-table tab, the side record). It sits at the scroller's bottom when the face is height-bounded (the list page).

**One bar everywhere:**

- `ObjectGrid` draws the same bar on every face. The portal into the page header and the bottom strip are gone.
- `useListPageBarHost` / `ListPageBarState` (never published; absent from `@object-ui/plugin-grid@18.6.0`) are replaced by `useListPageScope(scope)` (`listPageScope.ts`). The list page registers its page column with it. A grid inside it draws no row-end controls (#35554) and, with one record selected, offers that record's actions in the bar (`singleRowMenu`, in row-menu order, Delete last).
- Outside the list page the rows keep their own menu, and the bar offers the bulk actions at any count.
- `objectViewPageHeader.tsx`: the page header and the view bar no longer hide or swap on selection.

**Phone (card item 9):**

- Below 768px the grid draws cards, and the same bar floats over the card scroller, centred, on one line.
- List pages draw no phone bottom menu (`PhoneAppNavBar` is drawn only on Home/Notifications/Approvals), so there is nothing to replace there.
- The ways into selection on a phone are #35883's (seat note), and they land on this bar.

**Context menu:** unchanged.

**Not changed (reading accepted in the claim):** the non-grid ListView strip (kanban and the other non-grid views) keeps its own bar.

## Tests

Rewritten, because they asserted the retired faces:

- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/BulkActionBar.test.tsx`: fully rewritten. Old cases: the cross-page banner ("All N on this page are selected"), "Clear" text and the banner's clear. New cases: `planExposedEntries` (budget 3; all exposed at or under budget, Delete included; over budget the first admitted three; a narrower fit returns trailing entries in order), `singleRecordEntries` order, Delete-only → button, 3 vs 4+ actions, More contents (Delete last), one-record actions, 「Select all N」, the all-matching count, ×, Esc with the field / other-layer exceptions, Esc inside the dialog that holds the bar.
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/listPageBarSlot-35554.test.tsx` → `selectionBar-35678.test.tsx`. Removed: "two rows selected: … Cancel restores the page bar" and "CONTROL: a grid with no page bar keeps the bottom bulk bar". Added: the bar floats in the table with one record's actions, the room row comes and goes with ×, Esc clears, and with no list-page scope the same bar shows bulk actions. Kept: no Actions column, Shift-extend, right-click.
- `BulkActionBar.selectAllMatchingCap-28552.test.tsx`, `bulkActionRefresh.test.tsx`, `bulkFanoutHostParams.test.tsx`, `plugin-list/…/ListView.crossPageSelectAll.test.tsx`: banner assertions became assertions on the count chip's text and `title`. The offer reads `Select all N` (`grid.selectAllTotal`).
- `app-shell/…/ObjectView.bulkWiredHeaderDuplicate-12462.test.tsx`: the selection face testids became the bar's (`bulk-actions-bar`, `bulk-selection-clear`).
- `ui/e2e/list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts`:
  - Rewritten: the two-rows case (it asserted the page header hides and that nothing floats over the rows; it now asserts the opposite), the one-row case and the select-all case.
  - Added: 8 cases for the bar on the list page, a child-table tab and the side record, in light and dark, plus 375px.
- `examples/app-showcase/e2e/bulk-capability-gate.spec.ts`: three exposed defs instead of two.

Only import paths changed (`../components/SelectionBar`): `BulkActionBar.deleteLabel.zh-28910`, `BulkActionBar.regionName.zh-12145`, `bulk-action-visible`, `bulkActionCapabilityGate`, `lookupPredicateParity`.

Added: `types/…/data-table-declared-keys-6882.test.ts` pins `floatingBar` as declared with type `React.ReactNode`. `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` lists it in the DataTableSchema drift entry.

## Acceptance notes

1. Bottom centre of the list area, 「已选 N 条」 + ×, ≤3 labelled actions, rest in 「更多」, a single action is a button: yes (e2e measures the bar's centre against the scroll box's, ±1px).
2. Above the footer calc row, last row fully visible: yes (e2e: bar bottom ≤ tfoot top; after scrolling to the end, the last row's bottom ≤ the bar's top, on the list and on the child tab).
3. Top of the page does not change: yes (e2e: `page-header` stays visible).
4. × / Esc clear; 「选择全部 N 条」 when the page is all selected: yes.
5. One bar for main list, child tabs, side record, embedded tables; old strip and page-bar face retired: yes.
6. Phone: the bar works at phone width over the card face; list pages have no bottom menu to replace.
7. Context menu unchanged: yes (right-click e2e case kept).
8. Dark theme edge; 375px no wrap/overflow: yes (e2e: border ≠ background in dark; at 375px `scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth`, height 44, inside the window).

Follow-up, not in this PR: `grid.bulkAllOnPage`, `grid.bulkSelectAllMatching` and `grid.selectedAllLoaded` are no longer read by any source. Retiring them from the 11 packs is a separate i18n card.

## Verification

- Unit: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid packages/plugin-list packages/components/src/renderers/complex` (cwd `ui/`): 517 files, 4837 tests, all pass. `packages/types/src/__tests__` + data-table renderers: 432 files, 10784 tests, all pass. `packages/i18n/src/__tests__` + console `registry-inputs-spec-parity`: all pass. `packages/cli` i18n-bulk-action-coverage / i18n-walk-output-parity and `packages/lint` i18n-walk: pass.
- Type check: plugin-grid, components, types (`tsc --noEmit` + test configs), `type-check:e2e`: clean.
- Browser (Chromium, real components bundled by Vite from source, real Tailwind): `ui/e2e/list-no-actions-column-35554.spec.ts`, 24 of 24 pass, before and after merging `main`. Two defects the jsdom tests could not see were found and fixed:
  1. With the anchor inside a scroller that grows with its rows (a child tab, the side record), the bar sat at the end of the rows instead of the bottom of the window. The anchor now sits after the scroller.
  2. At 375px a stylesheet that arrived after the bar drew left it overflowing. The fit now re-measures on the bar's own resize.
- Screenshots (main list, child tab, side record; light and dark; 375px) are kept with the card thread's evidence.
- Derived gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: 63 derived, 62 run and exit 0, 1 NOT-MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3: it needs dists of server packages this diff does not touch; CI builds them).
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: clean against `origin/main`, #35994 and #35983.
